final: WITH per_album AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track WHERE AlbumId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM per_album) SELECT p.AlbumId, p.avg_price, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM per_album p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, (p.avg_ratio - o.overall_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
